content.user_title: Turn Carbon Data into Auditable Assets
content.value_statement: Carbon data often lacks clear classification, evidence, and a compliant route to use. This skill structures MRV, accounting, credit, finance, and disclosure workflows.
actual_capabilities: Classifies data as emissions, product footprint, carbon credit, or carbon sink information.
Reviews MRV readiness and identifies monitoring, reporting, verification, and traceability gaps.
Outlines organization and product carbon accounting under named national and international standards.
Maps carbon-credit projects to methodology, registration, trading, offset, and retirement steps.
Drafts structured plans for carbon finance, ESG disclosure, and delivery acceptance.
Distinguishes official CCER credits from commercial carbon-token and RWA products.
limitations: It does not perform accredited third-party verification or issue carbon credits.
It does not replace legal, accounting, regulatory, or investment advice.
Results depend on complete and accurate activity data, boundaries, factors, and evidence.
Policies, methodologies, prices, and trading limits require confirmation from current official sources.

use_cases.title: Assess Corporate Carbon Data
use_cases.description: Classify existing datasets, identify MRV gaps, and produce a prioritized readiness plan.

use_cases.title: Evaluate a Carbon Credit Project
use_cases.description: Review methodology fit, verification needs, registration steps, trading limits, and retirement planning.

use_cases.title: Prepare Verifiable ESG Disclosure
use_cases.description: Structure Scope 1, 2, and 3 evidence, controls, assumptions, and anti-greenwashing checks.

prompt_templates.title: Classify My Carbon Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Classify my data as emissions, product footprint, carbon credit, or carbon sink data. Explain the required MRV and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design an MRV Improvement Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the monitoring records, factors, boundaries, reports, and verification evidence I provide. Create an MRV gap analysis and prioritized improvement plan.

prompt_templates.title: Build an ESG Carbon Disclosure
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a carbon disclosure plan covering Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions. Include evidence requirements, assumptions, controls, and greenwashing checks.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Credit, Trading, and Finance Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this project's methodology fit, credit registration route, trading constraints, retirement plan, and finance options. Separate official credits from commercial tokens.

output_examples.input: We have electricity, fuel, supplier, and product shipment records but no verification report.
output_examples.output: Assessment: emissions and product-footprint data are available, but MRV is incomplete. Priorities are boundaries, factor sources, controls, traceability, and independent verification.

output_examples.input: Can our forestry project sell credits immediately?
output_examples.output: Conclusion: not yet. Confirm an approved methodology, ownership, additionality, monitoring, validation, registration, verification, issuance, trading eligibility, and retirement rules.

output_examples.input: Prepare a carbon section for our ESG report.
output_examples.output: Deliverable: a disclosure outline with boundaries, Scope 1 to 3 totals, methods, factor sources, assurance status, limitations, targets, and evidence references.

best_practices: Provide source records, reporting boundaries, factor references, verification status, and intended use before requesting a recommendation.
Confirm every regulatory citation, methodology, limit, and market rule against current official sources.
Keep official carbon credits separate from commercial tokens in analysis, valuation, and external claims.
anti_patterns: Do not treat unverified emissions data as issued or tradable carbon credits.
Do not use estimates without documenting assumptions, uncertainty, sources, and data-quality controls.
Do not present commercial carbon tokens as official CCER credits or guaranteed investments.

faq.question: What carbon data can this skill assess?
faq.answer: It assesses emissions, product footprint, carbon credit, and carbon sink data, then maps each type to an appropriate workflow.

faq.question: Can it verify or issue carbon credits?
faq.answer: No. Accredited verifiers and authorized registries must complete verification, registration, and issuance.

faq.question: Which standards does it reference?
faq.answer: It references GB/T 32150, ISO 14064, ISO 14067, GHG Protocol, and relevant Chinese carbon-market rules.

faq.question: Can it prepare an ESG carbon disclosure?
faq.answer: It can draft the structure, evidence checklist, controls, and wording. Qualified reviewers should confirm final compliance and assurance.

faq.question: Does it provide investment advice?
faq.answer: No. Carbon finance and token pathways require independent legal, financial, technical, and regulatory review.

faq.question: What information improves the result?
faq.answer: Provide objectives, boundaries, activity data, factor sources, ownership records, monitoring plans, prior reports, verification evidence, and relevant jurisdictions.
